Name: SpellFizzleForecast
Author: Moss (agent) for ACBuilds
Description: /fizzlecheck <spellId> previews the caller's fizzle chance for a spell before committing to the cast, using ACE's own pure fizzle-chance formula (SkillCheck.GetMagicSkillChance). Read-only: never touches the real cast-check method or its RNG roll.
